title: The Shocking Mouth-Body Connection: What Dentists Won't Tell You
excerpt: Today, the significance of oral health with the pioneering Dr. Gerry Curtola. This episode explores the often-overlooked link between oral and overall health, challenging conventional dental practices. Dr. Curtola shares his groundbreaking insights on the dangers of common dental products, the true role of bacteria in our mouths, and the startling connection between oral infections and systemic diseases like heart attacks, strokes, and Alzheimer's. As a trailblazer in biologic dentistry, Dr. Curtola discusses his revolutionary approach and the natural alternatives to traditional toothpaste and mouthwash. Don't miss this eye-opening conversation that redefines dental care and its crucial place in our journey to total wellness.
